'''Master designer''' was a title held by a chief [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] of the [[Unidentified Iokath species|species]] that dominated [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Master designers oversaw the [[Species/Legends|species']] weapons tests against inhabited planets, and the [[Master Designers Council]] ordered the construction of the artificial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iokath]]. Master Designer [[Vel Jyc Boer]] built the artificial intelligence [[SCORPIO]].<ref name="TOR KOTE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>
